methodology.confirmedDefinition: Named visits are confirmed from direct recollection. A Michelin-starred venue counts only when every plausible visit year is documented as starred by the relevant guide edition.
methodology.guideVsStar: Michelin Selected, Bib Gourmand, Green Star and Michelin Stars are separate distinctions; Michelin Selected is not a Michelin star.
methodology.editionCaveat: A restaurant may earn its star partway through a year. The starred-venues counter describes the venue's guide recognition, not proof that the star was already awarded on the dinner date.
methodology.unreconciled: The exact visit day remains unrecorded for some restaurants. Historical Michelin star counts require evidence for all possible years and do not imply an invented date.

methodology.jamesBeard: James Beard recognitions record award category, result (winner/finalist/semifinalist), year, the honoree, and associated restaurant. Chef recognition does not mean the restaurant itself won an institutional award. Award years after a meal remain subsequent achievements. A restaurant recognized after a user's visit may be tagged as subsequently awarded, rather than suggesting it held the award on the dinner date.
methodology.interview: Interview candidates are research leads except those expressly flagged as confirmed and linked to a canonical dining visit. Client selections remain browser-local and cannot override the canonical confirmed visit.
methodology.timeline: Visit years are user-chosen approximate chronological placements when exact dates are unknown, not verified day-specific dates. Approximate placement must be marked separately from award dates.
methodology.plate: The historical Michelin Plate is a recommended-restaurant designation, not a Michelin star. A Plate in a known guide edition does not imply it existed on an unknown meal date.
methodology.founderRecognition: If a founder won a James Beard award for a different restaurant, preserve the credited venue and never attribute the award to the visited branch.
methodology.favorites: Favorite dining experiences are user-designated and do not imply external culinary awards.
methodology.curated: Default Culture Passport dining views show confirmed restaurants with documented Michelin Guide recognition (star, Bib, Selected, historic Plate) or directly associated James Beard awards, finalists or semifinalists. Those awards retain their recipient and year. Chef awards at unrelated restaurants or historical awards dated after a dinner may be context, not proof of qualification at the meal date. Unverified and outside-scope visits stay in archive but are hidden from curated browsing by default.
methodology.repeatVisits: A legacy venue record can list multiple confirmed visitYears; Culture Passport canonical stores each year as its own visit, linked to one venue.

entries.name: Mister Oso

visit.source: Alex confirmed visiting Mister Oso in Denver. A reservation screenshot identifies Wash Park in March 2024, but a completed booking alone does not establish the date of the visit.

guide.note: The original RiNo location has held a Michelin Bib Gourmand since Colorado's 2023 Guide. The Culture Passport presents Mister Oso as one brand with multiple Denver locations; a Bib is not a star.

entries.summary: What began at Señor Bear in LoHi grew into something more playful. Chef Blake Edmunds took the energy of Señor Bear’s Latin-inspired happy hours and built Mister Oso around tacos, ceviche, cocktails and a colorful, tropical atmosphere. The first Mister Oso opened in RiNo in the former Populist space in November 2019. Its popularity led to a second location in Wash Park in summer 2022. You've confirmed eating at Mister Oso, and the Wash Park restaurant appears in your reservation history. Along the way, the original restaurant earned a Michelin Bib Gourmand in 2023. The link between those neighborhoods, the food and the wider Denver dining scene is the story worth keeping.

curation.reason: Original RiNo restaurant earned Michelin Bib Gourmand beginning in 2023. User confirmed a Mister Oso visit, with documentary evidence relating to Wash Park; keep one entry for the restaurant concept, not a claim that the specific meal received a distinction.

excludedResearch.explanation: Michelin did not publish any US restaurant guide until 2005. No Wisconsin Dells restaurant could hold a US Michelin star in the late 1990s.
